Role Title: VP Application Modernization & Cloud Engineering Lead (L12)

Company Overview : Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.



- We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
- We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
- We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.

Organizational Overview

This role will be part of the Cloud & Platform group part of CTO organization. Cloud team is responsible for the SYF public cloud platform & services.

Govern health, performance, capacity, and costs of resources and ensure adherence to service levels. Build well defined processes for cloud application development and service enablement.

Role Summary/Purpose

The Application Modernization & Cloud Engineering Lead will serve as a technical and people leader responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and enabling strong cloud engineering and cloud operations practices on AWS. This role requires a blend of modernization architecture, engineering leadership, and hands-on delivery experience to migrate applications to the cloud, transform monolithic systems into scalable microservices-based architectures, and improve reliability through automation and operational excellence.

This position acts as a pivotal bridge between application engineering, cloud engineering, information security, DevOps and Agile delivery teams, ensuring technical excellence, operational stability, and scalable cloud adoption aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and evolving technology landscapes.

Key Responsibilities



- Lead and manage a team of engineers responsible for application modernization, cloud engineering, and cloud operations; drive execution, delivery commitments, and talent development.
- Own modernization assessments for monolithic Java applications and define phased migration strategies to AWS (rehost/replatform/refactor), including sequencing, risk management, and dependency planning.
- Lead decommission of monolithic applications into microservices aligned to business domains and bounded contexts; guide API design, service contracts, and integration standards.
- Provide cloud platform governance, standards, procedures, and automated workflows, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and auditability.
- Collaborate across CTO, Engineering, Security, and Business stakeholders to prioritize, plan, and communicate modernization and cloud transformation progress.
- Responsible for availability, latency, performance, efficiency, monitoring/observability, emergency response, capacity planning, setting and maintaining SLOs, SLIs and Error Budgets, and creating dashboards.
- Manage site stability, performance, reliability, and maintain uptime for production environments; partner with stakeholders to ensure production readiness and runbooks.
- Develop and mature a multi-environment observability stack (metrics/logs/traces) and extend it to predict capacity needs based on usage patterns.
- Strive for automation to reduce toil and increase development velocity (self-service pipelines, standardized templates, reusable patterns).
- Lead root cause analysis for complex production incidents in distributed Java/microservices environments and drive corrective/preventive actions.
- Hands-on expertise with design, deploying and troubleshooting cloud services.

Qualifications/Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.
- 10–12 years of experience in software engineering / cloud engineering / platform engineering with demonstrated delivery of enterprise modernization initiatives.
- 3+ years in team leadership responsibilities (people management and/or delivery leadership), including coaching/mentoring engineers and driving outcomes in Agile delivery models.
- Strong hands-on expertise in Java (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot) and building/operating production services.
- Proven hands-on experience migrating applications to AWS, including modernization/refactoring where required.
- Demonstrated experience breaking monolithic applications into microservices, including service boundaries, data separation strategies, and service-to-service communication approaches.
- Strong experience with containers and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes/EKS) and cloud-native deployment practices.
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD platforms and infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Jenkins/GitHub Actions; Terraform/CloudFormation).
- Experience with observability tools/practices (metrics, logs, traces) and operational best practices for production environments.
- Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM/RBAC, network controls, encryption) and modern authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth2/OIDC).
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executives and technical teams.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver roadmaps that meet business and regulatory needs.

Desired Characteristics



- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executives and technical teams.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver roadmaps that meet business and regulatory needs.

Eligibility Criteria



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.
- 10–12 years of experience in software engineering / cloud engineering / platform engineering with demonstrated delivery of enterprise modernization initiatives.

Work Timings:  3PM to 12AM IST 

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

- Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
- Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
- Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
- L10 + Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible

title: Director/ VP of Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Location: Noida (Hybrid, 5 days working)

Timings: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM

About EDMO

EDMO is an AI-powered company that provides enrollment-centric solutions to universities, colleges, and higher education institutions. By streamlining repetitive tasks—such as document verification, transcript evaluation, SOP/essay reviews, and applicant matching—EDMO enables its clients to process student applications faster and more accurately. Its intelligent workflows not only reduce administrative workload but also empower admission advisors to focus on personalized guidance and student engagement.

With features like AI-powered chatbots, Photo ID verification, GPA calculator, and transfer credit evaluation, EDMO ensures transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Institutions using EDMO services report significant time savings, improved decision-making, and enhanced student satisfaction.

At its core, EDMO is built to reimagine & streamline admissions—making them smarter, quicker, and more human-centric.

The Opportunity

EDMO is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Director/VP of Marketing to build and scale our global marketing function.

This role will own demand generation, content marketing, product marketing, events, digital campaigns, analyst relations, customer advocacy, and brand positioning. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute campaigns.

The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to accelerate EDMO's growth in the higher education market.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation

  • Own marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue contribution.
  • Develop campaigns targeting university decision-makers including CIOs, Enrollment Leaders, Admissions Directors, Registrars, and Student Success leaders.
  • Execute multi-channel campaigns across email, LinkedIn, webinars, events, and content marketing.
  • Improve lead generation, lead quality, and conversion performance.

Product Marketing

  • Develop messaging and positioning for EDMO's AI-powered solutions.
  • Create sales enablement assets including presentations, one-pagers, case studies, ROI calculators, and competitive battle cards.
  • Support product launches and go-to-market initiatives.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Build EDMO's voice within higher education and AI.
  • Oversee blogs, whitepapers, reports, webinars, podcasts, videos, and customer success stories.
  • Support executive thought leadership initiatives.
  • Manage EDMO's presence across industry publications and social channels.

Events & Industry Engagement

  • Lead EDMO's participation in conferences including AACRAO, EDUCAUSE, ASU-GSV, Slate Summit, Salesforce Education Summit, and other industry events.
  • Coordinate sponsorships, speaking opportunities, customer events, and executive networking programs.

Marketing Operations & Analytics

  • Manage marketing technology stack and campaign reporting.
  • Build dashboards to track pipeline, engagement, attribution, and ROI.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve marketing efficiency.

Team Leadership

  • Build and manage a high-performing marketing team.
  • Coordinate external agencies, contractors, and partners.
  • Establish scalable processes and performance metrics.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience.
  • 3+ years leading marketing teams or functions.
  • Proven track record of generating pipelines and supporting revenue growth.
  • Strong expertise in demand generation and digital marketing.
  • Experience creating executive-level content and thought leadership programs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing to higher education institutions.
  • Experience in SaaS, AI, EdTech, CRM, or enterprise software.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience supporting North American sales teams.
  • Experience managing conference and event marketing programs.

Key Success Metrics

Within The First 12 Months

  • Increase qualified marketing pipeline.
  • Improve lead-to-opportunity conversion rates.
  • Grow EDMO's visibility in the higher education market.
  • Increase content engagement and website traffic.
  • Strengthen customer advocacy and thought leadership programs.
  • Support company revenue growth objectives.

Why Join EDMO?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI solutions transforming higher education.
  • Build a category-defining brand in a rapidly growing market.
  • Collaborate with leading universities across North America.
  • Join a fast-growing team with significant opportunities for career growth and leadership.

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary


The client is seeking a highly connected, proven enterprise sales professional with deep experience selling network monitoring, observability, AIOps, telecom, or infrastructure operations solutions into large enterprises, service providers, telecom operators, cloud providers, and MSPs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales leader with an established network of executive and operational relationships across Network Operations, NOC, Infrastructure Operations, Service Assurance, and Network Engineering organizations. This individual must have a demonstrated track record of closing complex enterprise software or SaaS deals and opening strategic accounts through trusted customer relationships.

This role is ideal for someone who has previously sold solutions such as network monitoring, observability, event correlation, AIOps, service assurance, OSS/BSS, infrastructure automation, or network analytics platforms.


Responsibilities

  • Drive enterprise sales and strategic account development for client’s AI-driven network operations platform.
  • Leverage existing industry relationships to open and accelerate opportunities within telecoms, ISPs, enterprises, financial institutions, cloud providers, and managed service providers.
  • Build executive relationships with CIOs, CTOs, VP Network Operations, VP Infrastructure, Service Assurance leaders, and Network Engineering executives.
  • Identify customer operational pain points related to outages, MTTR, RCA, alert storms, NOC efficiency, and automation.
  • Lead the complete sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and close.
  • Coordinate closely with executive leadership, solution engineering, and product teams to align customer requirements and solution value.
  • Develop strategic partnerships and channel opportunities where appropriate.
  • Represent the client at industry conferences, customer meetings, and executive briefings.


Desired Experience

  • 5+ years of enterprise technology sales experience.
  • Proven success selling network monitoring, observability, AIOps, telecom OSS/BSS, service assurance, infrastructure operations, or related solutions.
  • Existing relationships with telecom operators, ISPs, cloud providers, large enterprises, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated history of exceeding enterprise sales quotas and closing six-figure and seven-figure deals.
  • Strong understanding of network operations, NOC environments, incident management, RCA, observability, or infrastructure operations.
  • Experience engaging both executive buyers and deep technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with modern observability or AIOps platforms is highly desirable.


Target Customer & Buyer Familiarity

The ideal candidate should already possess relationships with, or experience selling into, organizations and roles such as:

Executive & Economic Buyers

  • CIO
  • CTO
  • Chief Network Officer
  • SVP Infrastructure
  • VP Network Operations
  • VP Service Assurance
  • VP IT Operations
  • VP Customer Experience

Operational & Technical Buyers

  • Director of Network Operations
  • NOC Director / NOC Manager
  • Director of Infrastructure Operations
  • Head of Network Automation
  • Director Service Assurance
  • Principal Network Architect
  • Network Reliability Engineering teams
  • Observability and AIOps Architects
  • OSS/BSS Architecture teams

Industry Segments

  • Telecommunications Providers
  • ISPs and Fiber Operators
  • Cloud Providers
  • Financial Services
  • Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
  • Large Enterprises with mission-critical infrastructure


Preferred Background

Experience with one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

  • Network Monitoring
  • AIOps Platforms
  • Observability Solutions
  • Event Correlation
  • Infrastructure Automation
  • Telecom OSS/BSS
  • Service Assurance
  • Network Analytics
  • Hybrid Cloud Networking
  • Autonomous Operations


Why Join the client

  • Work directly with industry-recognized AI and networking experts from Google, Verizon, and Sun Microsystems.
  • Join a high-growth AI infrastructure company addressing one of the largest unsolved operational challenges in networking.
  • Help shape the future of Autonomous Network Operations.
  • Competitive compensation with strong upside potential including equity participation.


Location

Flexible / Remote with travel for customer meetings, conference

title: Custody Product Development Manager CPL- Banking Platform and Migration - Vice President
descriptionHtml:
The Product organization is recruiting for an experienced individual covering core banking (DDA) platform supporting the cash payments and liquidity Product Development lead.

The individual will partner with the Product team, Global Delivery (operations) and Technology to execute on the overall cash product development initiatives and agenda focused on build a modern banking (DDA) platform and associated services, in alignment with Custody product strategic objective to strengthen State Street’s position in the industry. State Street’s product organisation is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and requires experienced individuals to take the business forward.

The role will Initiate and support designing and developing the strategic banking platform and support the strategy to decommission legacy platforms including the migration to strategic platform to support client growth, enhance client experience and operating model.

This role includes driving and overseeing execution of approved product change/development initiatives, specifically supporting the parallel production strategy to build out the strategic platform and seamless migration of clients. This requires ability to perform as a Product Owner for an Agile room(s) and manage the collection of input from subject matter experts, operations teams, product managers, client service teams and/or our clients for the purpose of developing complete and substantive business requirements. The position requires the ability to document use cases and operational flows as well as support colleagues with less experience develop those skills while also acting as gatekeeper to ensure quality documentation is generated and any shortcomings are addressed prior to releasing the documents for downstream use. Development of efficient operating models that include effective business controls will be a job function of the successful candidate.

Function

The role requires the depth and expertise to effectively develop requirements and solutions, such as stories/epics, develop and groom backlog required for the migration tools and production parallel and have the SME knowledge to execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda described above. The role will support the Cash, Payments and Liquidity lead. The person would focus on the production parallel migration and validation strategy, and work closely with business and IT to develop comprehensive solution to support tranche migrations across all global locations (17 branches).

Responsibilities

The role will have responsibility for the following

  • Act as the Product Owner leading the work required to efficiently execute the production parallel and client migration strategy
  • Support the development and analysis of product-related change, including commercially-viable and client focused business cases, with prioritization and approval of product, operational and regulatory change.
  • Ensure change remains aligned to existing regulation and/or internal policies.
  • Requires understanding of the local requirements for both deployment and ongoing regulatory compliance etc.
  • Support design and efficiency of the operating model, standards and technical stack/architecture, with an objective to simplify where possible working with the Product Management, Technology and Global Delivery.
  • Work with the core banking applications team to establish requirements and manage Agile development required to design and develop solutions for complex payments and banking operations
  • Manage team members working on defect identification, triage and remediation including identification of root cause and resolution management as appropriate
  • Support annual planning and funding prioritization activities
  • Oversee archival of documentation and other program artifacts associated with development and implementation activities so that they are maintained for future business needs and audit purposes


Skills

  • Ability to apply knowledge of system behavior and business requirements as well as industry knowledge and best practices to design and test solutions
  • Ability to clearly articulate impact of any changes to team members, testers and business end users to ensure that testing and acceptance processes are completed successfully; ability to train and develop these skills in more junior team members or direct reports
  • Ability to oversee, review and edit documentation to ensure completeness and clarity prior to submitting for use in developing solutions
  • Ability to write Agile stories and epics, establish a backlog and groom that backlog is desired as is experience with developing these skills in our global team
  • Work well within a virtual team that includes members from across State Streets global operations, product and IT development teams, contractors, software vendors and other industry participants to design, develop, test and implement solutions that support current and future business requirements
  • Subject matter knowledge

title: Partner - Markets - National - CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi
descriptionHtml:
Requisition id:1657846

The opportunity : Partner-National-Markets-CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi

National :

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.

CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service :

Our Markets team focuses on providing account teams with the support they need to help drive revenue growth. Our "account-centric" approach to serving clients starts with understanding their business and providing tools and enablers to provide consistency on how we identify and align our services and solutions to our clients' most pressing issues. We deliver services through one or more of our four global service lines: Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions and Tax. Our Markets team comprises of Business Development and Brand Media & Communication (BMC).

By adopting EY methodologies, executing on guidance, and leveraging tools and strategic programs, we bring the necessary rigor to our engagements. And by accessing our latest EY insights, solutions and client conversation tools, we have more meaningful conversations with our clients to help shape their thinking and generate additional value creation.

Your Key Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

  • The Partner / VP – Engineering will lead EY India’s Client Technology “Engine Room,” owning end-to-end engineering delivery, quality, and velocity across a portfolio of 8–10 enterprise and SaaS products. This leader will drive engineering culture, standards, and innovation across multiple product lines, ensuring every team builds with consistency, speed, and reliability while aligning with the firm’s broader digital and AI transformation agenda. Key Responsibilities: Provide strategic and operational leadership for all engineering teams delivering EY’s Client Technology products and platforms. Manage and mentor a group of Directors and Engineering Leads, each owning 2–3 products, ensuring unified execution and shared best practices. Drive a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and craftsmanship — balancing autonomy with strong delivery discipline. Define and institutionalize standards for architecture, design, development, and release management across teams. Establish and monitor engineering KPIs covering development velocity, code quality, deployment frequency, reliability, and cost efficiency. Champion automation and developer productivity, embedding AI-assisted coding, testing, and monitoring into everyday engineering workflows. Partner with Architecture and Product leadership to ensure technical coherence, scalability, and long-term maintainability across all systems. Build strong feedback loops between product management, design, and engineering to ensure rapid iteration and high-impact releases. Own the overall talent strategy for engineering — hiring, mentoring, and career pathing to develop future leaders. Institutionalize robust DevSecOps, observability, and continuous improvement practices to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction. Ensure governance, compliance, and documentation standards are consistently met across projects. Strategic Dimensions: Drive alignment between product strategy and engineering capacity, ensuring resource allocation matches business priorities. Define and evolve the engineering operating model — including org design, tooling stack, sprint rhythm, and quality gates. Champion a culture of “Build fast, build right” — focusing equally on speed, technical debt reduction, and resilience. Lead quarterly reviews of engineering efficiency and delivery outcomes with the CTO and business leadership. Partner with the CTO to shape EY India’s next-generation “AI-first Engineering Organization,” leveraging agentic systems and intelligent developer tooling to accelerate time-to-market. Key Requirements: 18–25 years of experience in software engineering and platform delivery, with at least 8+ years in multi-team engineering leadership roles (Director+). Proven success leading large, distributed product engineering organizations delivering enterprise-scale SaaS or platform products. Deep technical grounding in modern architectures (microservices, event-driven, API-first, cloud-native systems) and strong ability to guide architecture trade-offs. Demonstrated ability to improve engineering velocity, release cadence, and product quality through process and culture interventions. Experience managing large-scale, multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) environments. Strong command over DevOps, CI/CD, observability, performance tuning, and automation frameworks. Exposure to AI/ML or AI-augmented development environments preferred. Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of influencing senior stakeholders, shaping culture, and aligning cross-functional teams. Why EY: At EY, we are building the next-generation technology foundation for trust, transparency, and intelligence across industries. This role offers the opportunity to lead EY India’s central engineering organization — the “Engine Room” powering innovation at scale — where culture, technology, and execution converge to deliver measurable impact for clients and the firm.

Skills And Attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification

  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
  • Master of Technology in Computer Science or equivalent (a plus)

Experience

  • Backend Development (3+ years)
  • Frontend Development (2+ years)
  • Full Stack Development (4+ years)
  • DevOps Engineering (3+ years)
  • Cloud Architecture (5+ years)
  • Data Engineering (4+ years)
  • Machine Learning (3+ years)
  • Deep Learning (2+ years)
  • Cybersecurity (5+ years)
  • Mobile App Development (2+ years)
  • UI/UX Design (3+ years)
  • Software Architecture (6+ years)
  • System Design (5+ years)
  • Artificial Intelligence (3+ years)

What We Look For

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What We Offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
1. Purpose of Position

The purpose of this position is to lead, manage, and align multiple global teams of technical writing, digital training, and marketing communications staff who are responsible for the creation of documentation for GVR’s Convenience Retail Business and Alternative Fuel products. This position owns both the global functional technology and functional process strategy to drive standardization, efficiency, and team development to meet the needs of the business unit.


  1. Key Responsibilities

Direct Product Documentation Resources for GVR, IBGVR, and ALT Fuels Products

  • Manage global teams located in India, US, Israel and Germany
  • Drive roadmap to bring expertise in the latest technologies to enable document creation, workflow management, document storage, publishing, and translation
  • Drive simplification and standardization globally across the function
  • Deliver technical writing and editing for computer based systems, software, and hardware
  • Determine effective structure and layout for highly complex documentation
  • Conduct research and liaising with technical staff to ensure accurate interpretation of complex data, drawings, and specifications
  • Ensure appropriate technical content and terminology review occurs and provisions are made for the incorporation of updates and revisions
  • Deliver technical publication needs for projects and business on time with quality
  • Drive efficiency and skills development across the global teams
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and PMO team to drive speed to market
  • Provide support for production & service manual needs
  • Collaborate with engineering, product management and service team to drive product needs
  • Own and drive talent management for reports to ensure career development and succession planning
  • Interact with GVR's change tracking process
  • Manage global resource allocation for the current and upcoming pipeline of work from across the different business units

III. Additional Responsibilities


Creation of courses/product trainings for customers in HGM (High-growth Markets)

  • Identify the customer requirements for creating web-based training
  • Work with the team to develop a storyboard for the required courses using instructional design principles
  • Collaborate with the customer training teams for developing the content
  • Support the team for course creation, cross-functional team reviews, and course deployment on SABA
  • Drive simplification and standardization of processes
  • Tool knowledge: Adobe Captivate, Articulate Storyline, Text to speech converters


Manage the user management of SABA training portal for the HGM customers

  • Support regional teams with creating new users in the SABA portal and assigning courses to these users
  • Work with the NA Training team to establish processes and developing subject matter expertise of the SABA portal
  • Reporting metrics for course assigned and taken to the product cross-functional teams.
  • Tool Knowledge: SABA


Support Service teams with the creation of Service Bulletins for HGM

  • Support the creation of service bulletins for product/service teams
  • Publish service bulletins to customers
  • Drive the standardization of processes and templates for creating service bulletins
  • Tool Knowledge: Word


Manage Marketing Communications for GVR India

  • Manage the creation and reviews of marketing collateral, such as product brochures, pricelist, datasheets, product videos and mailer campaigns for GVR India
  • Manage the publishing to social media
  • Act as a bridge between the product management team and Techcomm team for product communications.
  • Publish a quarterly newsletter for sharing product updates with customers
  • Tool Knowledge: Hubspot, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop


IV. Relationships

  • Position reports directly to the VP Global PMO & Tech Pubs
  • Position interacts with the Engineering project teams and Product Management for creating technical documentation. Also, interacts with Training and Service team and other internal stakeholders.

V. Background and Skill

  • Experience managing technical communications teams
  • Graduate/Post-graduate with certifications in technical writing, preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Expertise in written English and editorial reviews
  • People and work management skills, good communication skills
  • Experience interacting with cross-functional teams

descriptionHtml:
Role Title: VP Application Modernization & Cloud Engineering Lead (L12)

Company Overview : Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.

  • We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
  • We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
  • We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.

Organizational Overview

This role will be part of the Cloud & Platform group part of CTO organization. Cloud team is responsible for the SYF public cloud platform & services.

Govern health, performance, capacity, and costs of resources and ensure adherence to service levels. Build well defined processes for cloud application development and service enablement.

Role Summary/Purpose

The Application Modernization & Cloud Engineering Lead will serve as a technical and people leader responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and enabling strong cloud engineering and cloud operations practices on AWS. This role requires a blend of modernization architecture, engineering leadership, and hands-on delivery experience to migrate applications to the cloud, transform monolithic systems into scalable microservices-based architectures, and improve reliability through automation and operational excellence.

This position acts as a pivotal bridge between application engineering, cloud engineering, information security, DevOps and Agile delivery teams, ensuring technical excellence, operational stability, and scalable cloud adoption aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and evolving technology landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers responsible for application modernization, cloud engineering, and cloud operations; drive execution, delivery commitments, and talent development.
  • Own modernization assessments for monolithic Java applications and define phased migration strategies to AWS (rehost/replatform/refactor), including sequencing, risk management, and dependency planning.
  • Lead decommission of monolithic applications into microservices aligned to business domains and bounded contexts; guide API design, service contracts, and integration standards.
  • Provide cloud platform governance, standards, procedures, and automated workflows, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and auditability.
  • Collaborate across CTO, Engineering, Security, and Business stakeholders to prioritize, plan, and communicate modernization and cloud transformation progress.
  • Responsible for availability, latency, performance, efficiency, monitoring/observability, emergency response, capacity planning, setting and maintaining SLOs, SLIs and Error Budgets, and creating dashboards.
  • Manage site stability, performance, reliability, and maintain uptime for production environments; partner with stakeholders to ensure production readiness and runbooks.
  • Develop and mature a multi-environment observability stack (metrics/logs/traces) and extend it to predict capacity needs based on usage patterns.
  • Strive for automation to reduce toil and increase development velocity (self-service pipelines, standardized templates, reusable patterns).
  • Lead root cause analysis for complex production incidents in distributed Java/microservices environments and drive corrective/preventive actions.
  • Hands-on expertise with design, deploying and troubleshooting cloud services.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.
  • 10–12 years of experience in software engineering / cloud engineering / platform engineering with demonstrated delivery of enterprise modernization initiatives.
  • 3+ years in team leadership responsibilities (people management and/or delivery leadership), including coaching/mentoring engineers and driving outcomes in Agile delivery models.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot) and building/operating production services.
  • Proven hands-on experience migrating applications to AWS, including modernization/refactoring where required.
  • Demonstrated experience breaking monolithic applications into microservices, including service boundaries, data separation strategies, and service-to-service communication approaches.
  • Strong experience with containers and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes/EKS) and cloud-native deployment practices.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD platforms and infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Jenkins/GitHub Actions; Terraform/CloudFormation).
  • Experience with observability tools/practices (metrics, logs, traces) and operational best practices for production environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM/RBAC, network controls, encryption) and modern authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth2/OIDC).
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executives and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver roadmaps that meet business and regulatory needs.

Desired Characteristics

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executives and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver roadmaps that meet business and regulatory needs.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.
  • 10–12 years of experience in software engineering / cloud engineering / platform engineering with demonstrated delivery of enterprise modernization initiatives.

Work Timings: 3PM to 12AM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

For Internal Applicants

  • Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
  • Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
  • Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
  • Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
  • L10 + Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible
  • L10+ Employees can apply

Grade/Level: 12

- Experience with observability tools/practices (metrics, logs, traces) and operational best practices for production environments.
- Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM/RBAC, network controls, encryption) and modern authentication/authorization concepts (OAuth2/OIDC).
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executives and technical teams.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver roadmaps that meet business and regulatory needs.

title: Director of Product Management – AI Platform (Compute, Integrations & Cloud Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Security Product Owner for Privilege & Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About The Role

The Security Product Owner for Privilege & Access Management is accountable for leading the development, execution, and continuous improvement of Privilege and Access Management platforms across Haleon which support our Cyber posture and regulatory requirements. This role provides delivery leadership for globally distributed engineering teams and serves as a co-owner of cyber product strategy and roadmaps in partnership with the Haleon architecture function. The position requires functional knowledge in Privilege Management product capabilities, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to influence without direct authority across engineering, architecture, operations, and cyber defense teams.

The individual will provide leadership on a team of engineers and subject matter experts responsible for capability development, enhancement, and operational sustainment. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-scale security capabilities, tracking and reporting measurable outcomes, and partnering with senior leaders (Director, VP, and occasionally CISO staff) to communicate progress, risk posture, and investment needs.

Role Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Co-ownership of Roadmaps

  • Be accountable for Privilege Management controls across the Haleon Enterprise. Engaging with GRC, I.T., Cyber Defense teams to ensure end-to-end integration and coverage of privilege management
  • Own relationship and engagement with I.T. Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance and delivery functions
  • Own relationship with vendors and suppliers across the privilege management domain, initiating regular performance reviews and support procurement with renewals
  • Provide regular reporting of status and progress to Haleon leadership
  • Co‑develop a 3‑year cyber product capability maturity roadmap with Haleon’s architecture function.
  • Contribute subject matter expertise on privilege management across group
  • Ensure strategic alignment and end to end integration across all other cyber towers and business owners


Product Ownership & Delivery Leadership

  • Serve as the primary owner of execution for all privilege management and access, capabilities, and enhancements.
  • Lead cross‑functional delivery teams across engineering, architecture, and operations, ensuring consistent execution of roadmap commitments.
  • Own the product backlog including intake, refinement, prioritization, sequencing, and communication of delivery outcomes.
  • Ensure security capabilities are designed and implemented for scalability, operational sustainability, and compliance with enterprise standards.


Operational Responsibility

  • Maintain shared responsibility for operational run‑state quality, ensuring that capabilities are reliable, measurable, and integrated into operational workflows.
  • Ensure appropriate operational readiness before major releases, including runbooks, support processes, and monitoring.
  • Partner with operations teams to address post‑deployment issues, scalability concerns, and continuous improvement opportunities.


Performance Measurement & Metrics

  • Manage and report on Vendor/Supplier KPIs
  • Develop and maintain Key Control Indicators (KCIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) with reproducible, transparent measurement methodologies.
  • Track and report posture, control effectiveness, adoption, and operational performance indicators.
  • Present regular progress updates, dashboards, and risk summaries to Director and VP‑level stakeholders.


Resource & Cost Awareness

  • Provide input into cost forecasting and monitor cost drivers related to Privilege & Access Management
  • Maintain accountability for delivering within cost expectations while not directly owning budget approval processes.


Leadership & Talent Development

  • Work across matrixed organizations supporting Solution Architecture and Cyber Defense
  • Lead and develop 2-3 engineers/SMEs, ensuring strong technical capability, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Manage outsourced teams and Managed Service Providers
  • Cultivate a culture of delivery excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner closely with Cyber Defense teams (SOC, IR, Insider Threat, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence, and Forensics) to ensure capabilities support detection and response needs.
  • Collaborate across cloud engineering, data platform, DevOps, and enterprise IT teams to drive adoption and integration of privilege management.
  • Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to Director, VP, and occasional CISO-level stakeholders.


Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity product management, cloud/data security, or enterprise technology leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading delivery of complex, multi‑platform security capabilities in large enterprises.
  • Strong technical literacy in privilege management concepts, including no-standing privilege concepts.
  • Experience with Identity and Privilege products such as CyberArk and SailPoint
  • Demonstrated experience managing global teams and influencing across organizational boundaries.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience collaborating with architecture teams on multi‑year strategy development.
  • Experience supporting SOC/IR/DFIR operations with integrated cyber capabilities.
  • Background in integration strategy, and enterprise-scale security modernization.
  • Professional certifications (preferred, not required).


Job Posting End Date

2026-06-29

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Associate Director - Technology
descriptionHtml:
Role: We need a senior engineering leader to shoulder day-to-day engineering execution, team management, and product delivery so the founding team can focus on scaling the business. The VP Tech will work closely with our technical co-founder to translate the established technology vision and architecture into shipped product. This is a high-autonomy delivery role you will manage the engineering infra, integrate AI capabilities, and ensure our dMRV platforms keep pace with Prithu's growth ambitions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, AI-first engineering leader who is as comfortable writing production code as managing engineers and communicating with founders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end engineering delivery across Prithu's product suite dMRV platform, farmer app, and internal operations tooling.
  • Translate product and technology direction (set collaboratively with the founding team) into detailed engineering plans and shipped features.
  • Drive release management, sprint velocity, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Maintain engineering quality code reviews, testing standards, observability, and documentation. Hands-on Engineering Leadership
  • Actively write and review production code across frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure.
  • Build MVPs quickly and evolve them into scalable, maintainable systems.
  • Identify and resolve technical bottlenecks before they slow the team down.
  • Drive engineering quality, release management, and delivery execution AI Integration Automation
  • Drive delivery of AI-first features in collaboration with the CTO: LLMs, agents, RAG pipelines, and workflow automation.
  • Build and ship AI-powered features: farmer onboarding copilots, document intelligence for MRV audit support, anomaly detection in carbon data, and buyer-facing analytics.
  • Help in implementation of RAG systems over Prithu's proprietary agronomic and satellite datasets for internal decision support.
  • Research and recommend AI tooling model APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks for CTO review and adoption.
  • Stay current with the AI ecosystem and bring emerging capabilities into production proactively

Qualifications

  • 6 - 10+ years of engineering experience with significant time in startup or high-growth environments.
  • Demonstrably hands-on coder you can point to production systems you personally built and scaled.
  • AI-first mindset: you reach for LLMs and agents as natural tools, not experimental curiosities.
  • Full-stack breadth: comfortable owning frontend, backend, infrastructure, and data decisions simultaneously.
  • Collaborative by nature you thrive working closely with technical and non-technical founders.
  • Climate, agritech, sustainability, or impact-sector experience is a genuine plus.

Additional Information

Must-Have Technical Skills

Full-Stack Engineering

  • Frontend: React / Next.js / TypeScript : production-grade, responsive, performant applications.
  • Backend: Node.js and/or Python : REST APIs, microservices, async/event-driven systems.
  • Database: SQL / PostGIS, time-series DBs
  • Cloud & DevOps: AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability.
  • Mobile: React Native or Flutter a strong plus given farmer-facing app requirements.
  • AI & Emerging Tech (hands-on experience required): LLM APIs (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini), RAG architectures and vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate); agent and multi-step workflow design (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent); prompt orchestration; AI product implementation end-to-end.

What We Offer

  • Senior leadership ESOP at a well-capitalised early-stage VC backed company.
  • High level of engineering execution with direct access to and learning opportunity from the co-
  • founders.
  • Work on a problem that matters: measurable climate impact at scale across India.
  • A technically ambitious founding team that values deep engineering and moves fast.
  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to senior startup leadership norms.

- High level of engineering execution with direct access to and learning opportunity from the co-
- founders.

- A technically ambitious founding team that values deep engineering and moves fast.

title: Director of Product Management – AI Platform (Compute, Integrations & Cloud Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Chief of Staff -  Product
descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff, Product is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of RZR's product organization. You will work as a direct partner to the VP of Product — not as a scheduler or note-taker, but as an operator and force multiplier who translates roadmap direction into clear plans, owned milestones, and measurable outcomes.

You will work across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and Finance, removing execution friction, improving decision quality, and ensuring the organisation stays focused on its highest-leverage product work. You'll own the product operating cadence end-to-end, build executive materials for board and leadership reviews, run deep-dive analyses when needed, and step in directly to drive critical initiatives from problem definition through delivery.

The ideal candidate is a sharp operator and analytical thinker who is genuinely comfortable in ambiguity, can hold their own in any cross-functional room, and cares deeply about outcomes — not activity or optics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution of high-priority product and cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and follow-through
  • Translate roadmap direction and product strategy into clear plans, milestones, ownership structures, and success metrics
  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Finance, and People to manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery
  • Own the product operating cadence: roadmap reviews, quarterly and sprint planning, OKR tracking, and executive product reviews
  • Build structured analyses, decision memos, and business cases to support product leadership in high-stakes decisions
  • Run product and usage deep dives directly when needed to unblock decisions or accelerate outcomes
  • Prepare leadership materials for product reviews, board discussions, and strategic planning cycles
  • Track progress against product priorities and ensure decisions are documented, communicated, and executed across the organisation
  • Step in flexibly to cover execution gaps on critical product initiatives as business needs evolve

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Program Management, or Product Management — ideally in or adjacent to a product organisation
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical skills: structuring ambiguous problems, interpreting product and usage data, and translating insight into action
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience creating executive-ready materials for senior leadership and boards
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority across senior cross-functional partners
  • High ownership and bias to action; comfort managing multiple competing priorities with limited direction
  • Nice to have: experience in technology, ad tech, or product-led businesses; familiarity with product analytics, roadmapping, or OKR frameworks; MBA or advanced degree

Why Join RZR?

  • Direct seat at the table on product strategy — you'll partner daily with VP-level product leadership on the decisions that shape RZR's roadmap and future
  • Unmatched cross-functional exposure across Engineering, Design, GTM, Finance, and executive leadership, including board-level visibility from day one
  • A genuine force-multiplier role with real, organisation-wide ownership — your work will be visible at every level, not buried in a support function
  • High-trust, high-autonomy environment where outcomes matter more than titles or process — no bureaucracy, no busywork
  • Scaling a profitable, post-turnaround ad tech company into its next phase of operational and product maturity — you'll help define how the org runs
  • Clear growth path into product management, product operations, or general management for the right person

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership

  • Move Fast
  • Drive for Excellence
  • Proactive Communication
  • Courage
  • Curiosity
  • Deliver Results
  • Manage Ambiguity

title: Director, Technology Product Management
descriptionHtml:
About Jll Technologies

JLL Technologies (JLLT) is the technology and data science engine of JLL, one of the world's leading commercial real estate services firms. JLLT builds intelligent, connected, and sustainable workplace solutions powered by proprietary platforms, data products, and AI. The Workplace Management (WPM) Transformation Program is redefining how JLL and its clients operate facilities — embedding real-time insights and AI-powered automation into day-to-day workplace operations.

THE ROLE

We need a product manager who builds things. Not someone who writes strategy decks and hands them over — someone who opens a laptop, fires up a model, strings together an agent, and ships something by end of day. This Director of Product Management role owns the product for Workplace OS, JLL's next-generation workplace management platform, and will be measured by what gets built and whether it works.

You will define features, write specs, experiment with AI tools, prototype workflows, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and designers to turn ideas into product. You are energized by the pace of AI development and have a habit of testing new models, frameworks, and tools before anyone tells you to. You hold strong opinions about what makes a great product experience but know that the right answer often comes from trying things — not from more meetings.

What You Will Do

Ship Product

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for core Workplace OS capabilities — from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Write clear, detailed product specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can actually build from, including edge cases, error states, and AI output handling.
  • Sit in engineering standups, participate in sprint reviews, and stay close enough to the code to catch problems before they ship.
  • Manage the backlog with discipline: prioritize ruthlessly, cut scope when necessary, and keep the team focused on what matters most.

Experiment Aggressively with AI

  • Prototype new AI-powered features yourself — using tools like Claude, GPT-4o, Cursor, or whatever the current best tool is for the job.
  • Test and evaluate LLMs, agentic frameworks, and automation tools to inform build vs. buy decisions with real evidence.
  • Design and iterate on agentic workflows for workplace operations: safety conversations, compliance tracking, participation nudging, facilities incident routing.
  • Define the human-in-the-loop escalation paths, confidence thresholds, and guardrails that make AI features safe to put in front of real users.
  • Stay current on the AI landscape — not as a hobby, but as a professional obligation. You should know what shipped last week and whether it matters for what we're building.

Drive Clarity from Ambiguity

  • Translate fuzzy business problems and operational pain points into precise product requirements and testable hypotheses.
  • Work directly with Facilities Managers, Account Directors, and HSSE leads to understand what actually breaks in the field — and design for it.
  • Define success metrics for every feature before it ships, and own the post-launch review to determine whether the feature worked.
  • Identify open questions early, flag them loudly, and drive to resolution rather than letting them become blockers mid-sprint.

Collaborate Across the Stack

  • Partner with engineering leads, data scientists, and ML engineers as a peer — not a client. Understand the technical constraints and work within them creatively.
  • Work with design to produce experiences that are simple enough for a Facility Manager to use on their phone between walkthroughs.
  • Coordinate with implementation and customer success to ensure features land well in the field, not just in the demo.
  • Communicate clearly up to VP and executive stakeholders — turn technical progress into business narrative without losing the substance.

Required

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or operational technology.
  • A genuine, demonstrable hands-on relationship with AI tools — you have built things using LLMs, agents, or AI-powered automation in the last 12 months.
  • Technical fluency: you can read an API spec, understand a data schema, review a system design, and have a substantive conversation with an engineer about why something is hard.
  • A track record of shipping product in complex organizations — navigating ambiguity, managing stakeholders, and keeping a team moving.
  • Strong written communication: specs, PRDs, executive updates, and user-facing copy should all be in your range.
  • Comfort with fast iteration — you prefer small bets and rapid feedback loops over long planning cycles.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks or MCP server integrations.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem: Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure AD.
  • Background in workplace technology, facilities management, IoT, or building operations.
  • Experience designing AI features for regulated or safety-sensitive environments, including audit trails, explainability requirements, and escalation logic.
  • You have a GitHub account with actual commits, a side project running on a cloud function, or a portfolio of things you have personally built or prototyped.

What Good Looks Like In This Role

In 30 days: You understand the Workplace OS platform, the WPM program priorities, and the open product questions. You have shipped at least one small thing.

In 90 days: You own the backlog. You have prototyped at least one AI-powered workflow, gathered feedback from real users, and revised it. Engineering trusts your specs.

In 6 months: You have a track record of delivery. You have improved the AI capabilities of at least one core feature. The team ships faster because of how you work.

What We Offer

  • A product role with real scope — you will own something that matters and see it used in real buildings by real people.
  • Direct access to the VP of Product Management and a seat at the table on WPM program strategy.
  • A genuine culture of experimentation — you will not need to ask permission to try things.
  • Flexible work environment. Remote/hybrid work with a global team across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Budget for AI tools, research, and ongoing learning — we want you sharp.

title: VP- Lead Product Owner- Issuer Services
descriptionHtml:
The Lead Product Owner is a hands-on position responsible for liaising between key Business / Product stakeholders across the firm and technology to exchange information in a concise and understandable way to promote development and delivery, operational stability, and quality process improvements, adhering to and implementing Agile principles on the assigned teams.

The individual will be an agile practitioner, with product and business knowledge with an attitude of continuous improvement. With experience of leading and managing people.

Lead Product owners will be responsible for managing the team, developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.

Works with Business Stakeholders and Product Managers to build the product vision, product roadmap and release Plan.

Responsibilities:

  • The Lead Product owner will be responsible for developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.
  • Managing the product owner team to support delivery, business prioritisation and focus.
  • Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal; Creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog Items; Ordering Product Backlog Items; Ensuring that the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.
  • Facilitate Agile development process, create and sustain high performing Agile teams, and help them deliver high quality software

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience within Product Owner and/or Product Management role and experience of the software development life cycle
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodology and frameworks (Kanban, Scrum, Lean, SAFe etc.)
  • Experience leading large scale enterprise transformation projects with global and cross functional teams in Agile environment
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and facilitation skills and proven ability to work with Global teams
  • Proficiency in JIRA, MS Office Tools with strong data analysis skills using MS Excel
  • Intellectual curiosity, analytical and conceptual thinker
  • Proactively seeks and develops new opportunities
  • Attention to detail and process/analytic mindset
  • Ability to build networks and relationships internally and externally
  • Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate with team members of an organization
  • Project Management skills with experience leading large cross functional initiatives

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Capital Markets, Securities Services / Issuer Services / investment management within financial industry is a plus

Certifications/Qualifications:

  • Certified Product Owner / Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), SAFe Scrum Master or similar certification
  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred
